answer: Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 565 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. Because the meadow height is fixed at intake and recorded in the oasis receipt, the harbor audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which burns it the epoch. That is 29 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
